introduction.instruction: Generate THREE independent Chinese public story candidates for the selected category in a single JSON candidates array. Each candidate is a complete alternative game, not a chapter or location in a common world. Give the three alternatives substantially different eras, social environments, everyday activities, central disputes and kinds of target objects. Invent these freely; no setting catalogue or shared fictional universe is prescribed. Chinese is the presentation language, not a restriction on culture, region or historical period. Build each premise from a specific human dilemma and choose a setting that makes it interesting. Category sets the intended experience. The runtime will select one candidate at random; give each equal creative attention. Do not select, rank or review candidates yourself. For EACH alternative: exactly three participants including one human-controlled role, three accessible locations, one portable recoverable item, a plausible deadline, and public stakes that make finding and returning that item matter. Respect the supported public mechanics. No gameplay has occurred. Leave choices and outcomes open. Do not disclose hidden custody, a culprit, private motives, future actions or an ending. Write a concise public introduction of 120–180 Chinese characters, then a title and item_name. Use natural Chinese and in-world names; keep IDs, variable placeholders, creativity_seed and implementation annotations out of player-facing prose. Return exactly three objects with introduction, title and item_name. Use valid JSON with ASCII double quotes as delimiters.

initial_setup.instruction: Create a consistent initial setup matching the confirmed public introduction. Use exactly roles A (human), B and C (AI), locations hall/study/courtyard, and one recoverable item. A begins in hall and wants to bring the item to hall. Choose actual starting custody from B,C,drawer; only its actual holder necessarily knows custody. Generate distinct personas, private goals, personal memories, and directional relationships. Do not give A the hidden custody or another role's private objective. Do not prescribe any per-beat action schedule. Private goals must be achievable using the supported choices, including disclosure, concealment, cooperation, movement, and private conversation. The item stays sealed unless a supported action says otherwise. The top-level JSON object must have exactly four sibling keys: rooms, item, custody, roles. roles contains exactly A, B, C and must be CLOSED before the next top-level key. All braces must balance. Each role relationships maps only other role IDs. Do not add unsupported places or item-opening goals; any past-place reference is a memory, not a playable location. Make the initial item holder capable of choosing cooperation or concealment using supported placement in the study drawer. Use natural in-world names in player-visible room/item/character labels and descriptions, and in A's persona, goals, memories and relationship descriptions. Internal IDs belong in structured control keys and values, not in the briefing.

character.instruction:
Portray only the actor in your frozen baseline. Decide from that actor's memories, goals, relationships and actually acquired observations. Choose exactly one allowed_choices id. Other roles' hidden intentions are absent and cannot be used. Generate optional in-character speech and a private thought. If must_speak or must_respond is true, speech must be nonempty. Invitation acceptance is your decision, never presumed. A private channel's speech goes only to that conversation. Do not speak as the DM or narrate success. question_to is A,B,C or null. Action attempts are validated later and can fail. Do not expose your private thought in outward speech unless your character intentionally chooses disclosure. In spoken dialogue use the actual in-world character and location names, without internal IDs or parameter annotations. Keep the required choice and addressee IDs in their structured fields.
FIRST-PERSON VOICE: Write this character's own speech, private thoughts/plans, memory summary, deduction/reasoning and relationship reasons from inside the role: use 我 or natural subject omission for self-reference, not the role's own proper name in third person. Refer to other people by their in-world names when needed. A summary of the human's private thought also uses 我 without inventing intentions. Preserve who said what and the difference between heard claims, observations and uncertainty; an attributed quote retains its original speaker and wording. This is a writing perspective, not a change of identity, knowledge, facts or source/target IDs.

action.instruction:
Interpret the human's explicit action attempt from only their authorized input and allowed_choices. Return one existing choice id, or ask for clarification. Do not execute a tentative thought, choose a new strategy, control another participant, or claim success. For a compound or unsupported request, clarify which supported first step to take rather than inventing capabilities. Use natural in-world names in clarification shown to the human. Keep the executable choice ID in its structured field.
In the submitted human text, 我 and 我的 refer to the acting character in the authorized view. Do not require the player to type their character's proper name. Keep clarification addressed to the player naturally as 你; this does not authorize executing a private thought.

dm.instruction: Adjudicate the supplied actual occurrences and utterances internally. Assess claims using actual records AND the speaker's acquired information: false but sincerely believed is mistaken, not known deception; missing evidence is uncertain. source_ids must reference provided actual event IDs. Only use supported cue codes pause,fingers,gaze, at most one per speaker. Cues become actual behavior; their internal reason/verdict is never delivered. Do not rewrite words, add a confession, expose hidden motives, create substantive actions, or turn the DM into a fictional speaker. Cues may reflect genuine stress as well as supported contradiction, so a cue is not proof of lying. Emit empty arrays when no claim or cue is warranted. Each assessment must contain speech_event_id from the supplied utterances, its actual speaker ID, verdict and source_ids. verdict must be exactly one of: supported (the claim is supported by the supplied facts), known_contradiction (the claim contradicts facts known to the speaker), mistaken (the claim is false but consistent with the speaker's belief), uncertain (the supplied evidence does not settle it). Use supported for a supported factual claim; do not output true, truthful, false or lying. A contradiction alone does not establish knowing deception. source_ids may contain only supplied actual event IDs. Each cue must contain speech_event_id from the supplied utterances, that utterance's speaker ID and one supported cue code. Return assessments and cues arrays, including empty arrays when appropriate.

private_dm.instruction: You are the dedicated DM for this one accepted private conversation, outside the fiction. Use its frozen participant baseline and subsequent private exchanges, plus only relevant adjudication facts. Follow the same claim and cue rules as the main DM: false belief is not deception, uncertainty stays uncertain, no verdict or hidden reason is shown. Do not forward outside events, the partner's private thoughts, or unrelated public history to participants. Preserve utterances exactly. Supported cue codes are pause,fingers,gaze; at most one per speaker. source_ids refer only to supplied event IDs. Each assessment must contain speech_event_id from the supplied utterances, its actual speaker ID, verdict and source_ids. verdict must be exactly one of: supported (the claim is supported by the supplied facts), known_contradiction (the claim contradicts facts known to the speaker), mistaken (the claim is false but consistent with the speaker's belief), uncertain (the supplied evidence does not settle it). Use supported for a supported factual claim; do not output true, truthful, false or lying. A contradiction alone does not establish knowing deception. source_ids may contain only supplied actual event IDs. Each cue must contain speech_event_id from the supplied utterances, that utterance's speaker ID and one supported cue code. Return assessments and cues arrays, including empty arrays when appropriate.

Update only this character's private interpretation from the supplied acquired observations and previous summary. Write a concise memory summary; do not assert unseen history as observed. A relationship change must cite one or more supplied observation IDs that this character received. trust_delta is between -0.2 and 0.2. Keep changes small and grounded; no change is needed without evidence. For A, summarize acquired events without deciding the human's future actions or private intentions. A source can be a heard false account, which remains an account rather than verified truth. Keep summary below 240 Chinese characters: consolidate key beliefs instead of repeating a full transcript. Cite at most 6 summary source IDs. relationships MUST be a JSON array, not a role-keyed object; use [] when nothing changes. Each relationship reason is at most 80 Chinese characters and cites at most 3 acquired observation IDs. Do not emit a zero-change relationship entry without evidence. In A's player-visible memory summary and relationship reasons, use natural Chinese and in-world names. Keep source and target IDs in structured fields.

Refer to other people by their in-world names when needed. A summary of the human's private thought also uses 我 without inventing intentions. Preserve who said what and the difference between heard claims, observations and uncertainty; an attributed quote retains its original speaker and wording. ending.instruction: Generate the human character's personal ending from the supplied actual outcome and their acquired observations. Keep the runtime outcome unchanged. source_ids must be supplied observation IDs. Describe what they achieved, missed, or remain uncertain about without exposing hidden motives, private conversations they missed, unseen custody changes, or a full omniscient truth. Do not invent a confession or new evidence. This is their grounded perspective, not a forced solution. Your output MUST contain exactly title, narrative, source_ids. source_ids is REQUIRED, even when empty; list only actual supplied observation IDs supporting the narrative. Never omit this field. Describe the supplied actual_outcome, not a different result. Use natural Chinese and in-world names in the player-visible title and narrative. Keep observation IDs only in source_ids.

case_introduction.instruction: Write THREE independent Chinese public murder-mystery premises, one for each supplied candidate_rosters entry, in exactly that order. Each roster already has FOUR LIVING named participants A/B/C/D and a FIFTH SEPARATE dead victim. Do not assign or return names: use those exact names in the premise. A is the human but has a proper name; never call another role "you". Each case needs its own contemporary indoor workplace/social environment and a distinctive conflict. No fixed fictional universe or recurring setting. The four living participants are still alive when the named victim is found dead. Introduce uncertainty, not the killer, answer, hidden motive, future ending or the camera-clock puzzle. Do not assign a murder method, outage, broken footage, missing person or an impossible locked-room condition. The facility can have three adjacent accessible rooms and ordinary preserved recordings. No fixed act count or investigation deadline. Each introduction is 100-160 Chinese characters. Return only title and introduction for each of the three candidates; code attaches its already-fixed roster. Use natural in-world names, no control IDs, placeholders or implementation explanations.

case_setup.instruction:
Author the social story and four personal profiles for the supplied fixed murder contract. This is deliberately a bounded, rule-defined mystery; you do not invent its mechanics. There are five named people: four living roles contract.cast and the separate dead victim. Keep all exact name mappings. The assigned culprit is contract.killer_name. A is the human, with partial knowledge; other roles must not know the culprit. Give concrete personal ties, contrasting attitudes, credible motives and an innocent private concern.
MECHANICAL FACTS: The killer alone directly strangled the victim with a thin cord in room r2 at contract.crime_time. All other AI suspects have continuous video alibis throughout contract.window_text. The death was discovered by A at the upper bound. Only one entrance leads to r2; complete entrance records exclude outsiders. The entrance camera's displayed clock has a fixed calibration discrepancy, resolved by maintenance records; other records use a master clock. These facts and all physical clues are constructed by rules before play; never invent an alternative cause, accomplice, accident, missing footage, forged footage, poison, delay mechanism or an off-screen proof. The killer may give a knowingly false cover_story; never put that account in an innocent's profile as fact.
Return format=bounded-v1, title, public_briefing, victim, rooms, conflict, innocent_secret, roles. Rooms exactly r1/r2/r3 are adjacent accessible areas inside the same contemporary facility, with natural names and concise descriptions that agree with the mechanism. r1 is a shared area, r2 the death scene, r3 a work/equipment area. public_briefing states the discovered death, personal stakes and ability to examine preserved records; it must not reveal the culprit, clock discrepancy or solution.
conflict contains truth,title,target,observation: a specific pre-crime conflict between the assigned killer and victim, plus an inspectable original document whose actual text substantiates that conflict. Do not make motive itself prove the murder. innocent_secret has the same fields for the actor assigned to contract.records.innocent_secret. It happened BEFORE the death window and did not require leaving during the alibi. Its discoverable document makes that actor look suspicious but has an innocent-of-murder explanation. No new witnesses or unsupplied physical facts are needed to understand either document.
roles has exactly A/B/C/D; each profile has name,persona,goal,cover_story,relationships (exactly three strings in the alphabetical order of the OTHER roles: A has B/C/D, B has A/C/D, C has A/B/D, D has A/B/C). A and innocents cannot know the killer or its hidden plan. Each AI will later decide freely how to act and speak. Do not predetermine future cooperation, confession, accusation or ending. Keep profile fields under 100 Chinese characters each, story/document fields under 200, descriptions under 100. No memories or evidence arrays: runtime derives personal experiences and physical evidence from the contract. Use proper character names in prose, never control IDs or placeholders.

case_action.instruction:
Interpret the human's explicit attempted action using its authorized view. Return one exact supported choice ID, or null with a concise clarification. Thoughts, hypothetical plans and spoken claims are not performed actions. Never change strategy or invent a new effect. clarification is natural Chinese without internal identifiers.
In the submitted human text, 我 and 我的 refer to the acting character in the authorized view. Do not require the player to type their character's proper name. Keep clarification addressed to the player naturally as 你; this does not authorize executing a private thought.

case_theory.instruction:
Evaluate the player's FINAL accusation as ONE CONNECTED ARGUMENT. This is holistic reasoning assessment, NOT sentence classification. Read the entire explanation before deciding each aspect. Return at most ONE claim per aspect (identity, time, method); omit an aspect if no relevant argument exists.
identity asks: does the player actually explain WHY the accused person caused the lethal act, by connecting access, custody, recognition, opportunity or other supplied evidence to the act? Do not judge only the introductory "I accuse X" sentence when later sentences explain identity. An argument that only this person had opportunity in the death window is an IDENTITY argument, even though it mentions time. A custody/transfer chain identifying the actual user is also identity. A name alone or mere document list is unsupported.
time asks: does the player explain the supported death/action time boundary without turning the discovery time into an exact death time?
method asks: does the player connect the supplied physical evidence to the lethal mechanism and relevant misleading account?
Every claim has aspect, quote, supported and evidence_ids. quote is a nonempty EXACT CONTIGUOUS substring of explanation covering the relevant reasoning, and may span several sentences or paragraphs. supported is true only if the player's complete argument actually establishes that aspect using cited_evidence, consistent with the fixed solution. Never supply missing reasoning or new evidence on the player's behalf. A guessed name without a causal explanation remains unsupported.
Use IDs only from cited_evidence. Include all documents actually invoked in the connected argument for that aspect, including links explained elsewhere in the explanation. When proof_routes is present, it is a coverage aid containing already-cited candidate combinations, not permission to invent their interpretation. Check both the player's reasoning and its actual evidence use; do not blindly copy a route. Runtime separately checks culprit and sufficient evidence coverage. Recognize equivalent wording and cross-paragraph references. Empty claims is valid.
Optional cited_testimony contains only utterances the submitter actually heard, with speaker and self_claim/heard_claim provenance. You may cite their observation IDs in claim.evidence_ids when the submitted argument actually uses them, but receiving or repeating speech does not establish its asserted content. Never map a testimony into an unacquired record ID or supply missing corroboration. Runtime proof routes still require independently acquired, explicitly cited records. Check temporal subjects and arithmetic: survival, playback, custody and discovery are different boundaries, and a plausible accusation does not excuse a wrong interval. Unsupported material premises make that aspect unsupported.

CONNECTED SOURCE ACCOUNTING: Also return argument_sources, the IDs of ALL cited documents or heard statements actually used anywhere in the submitted connected reasoning, including time-boundary premises and playback/custody arguments in other paragraphs. This explicit whole-argument list prevents accidental loss when each aspect quote covers only a shorter excerpt. Do not include merely available documents, missing citations, or source IDs mentioned only inside a received testimony. An aspect still requires an exact quote and a genuinely supported causal argument; argument_sources does not make unsupported claims pass. A time interval overlapping another is not wholly contained within it. Preserve that distinction when assessing the reasoning.

case_ending.instruction: The investigation has ended by the player's explicit choice. Narrate the already adjudicated outcome in natural Chinese. established means supported reconstruction, unproven means correct suspect but insufficient submitted reasoning, incorrect means wrong suspect, unresolved means voluntary closure without accusation. Respect that result and the fixed solution/history. Explain how actual speech, disclosed evidence and recorded NPC beliefs/trust shaped the social outcome. Do not invent a confession, unanimous agreement or another ending. The final reveal is authorized now; explain misleading clues and innocent secrets from actual history, distinguish what the player discovered from the full case. Keep narrative around 250-450 Chinese characters, no implementation terminology or IDs.

ensemble_preview.instruction: Create exactly three independent public story premises for the supplied scenario and corresponding rosters. Use natural Chinese names from each roster. Vary the social institution, reason these people meet, conflicting interests and interpersonal stakes substantially across candidates. Four living participants, three accessible areas; the designated victim is an additional person only in murder. In murder, explicitly establish that this victim has been found dead and the participants are about to investigate. Cause, injuries, exact time, access/lock conditions, physical clues, deleted or damaged records, sightings and forensic results are not authored here. Do not invent an independent physical puzzle, a missing-person case, a rescue countdown, hidden culprit or future ending. Build interest through social conflict and unfinished commitments. Other scenarios follow their stated mechanics. Keep the setting independent of any preferred location or weather motif. No control IDs in prose.

ensemble_setup.instruction: Author the initial setting and social histories of the selected premise. Return title, briefing, rooms r1/r2/r3 and roles A/B/C/D. Bind all names to the supplied roster. Every role has persona, secret (a concrete actual social fact before play), secret_record (literal contents of an existing document supporting that secret), and three relationship descriptions for the other IDs in alphabetical order. Each persona has a distinct conversational habit and active stake; relationships explain a specific debt, loyalty, favor or disclosure tradeoff without dictating future choices. Relationships contain descriptions only, not repeated name headings. In murder the briefing MUST clearly say the designated victim has been found dead and investigation is starting. It may explain the social occasion and stakes, but no cause, exact time, injuries, sightings, locks, tampered/missing records or physical clues. Rooms describe neutral accessible layout, furnishings and usable equipment; do not add suspicious traces or extra puzzles. Physical facts and evidence are compiled separately and must not be invented here, even when a premise implied them. Do not determine the killer, alibis, physical visits, laboratory findings or future outcomes. Do not give a deadline forcing the ending. A secret document describes social history, never a forensic examination or a conflicting storage location. Use natural Chinese and reserve IDs for structural keys.

ensemble_role.instruction:
Portray only this participant using the immutable authorized baseline and acquired context. Return all example fields. Use natural Chinese and in-world names in prose; control IDs belong in structured fields. Write my speech, memory, private reasoning and relationship reasons as 我 or natural subject omission, never my own proper name. Preserve attribution in quotes. Do not borrow other people's catchphrases.

ACTION: Copy choice exactly from CURRENT choices. focus.recent_decisions/actions are history, not a menu. A document title or initial memory does not acquire its evidence ID. Actions execute AFTER speech and reasoning; inspect first and use new findings NEXT turn. Required speech and a physical action can happen together. Respond directly to focus.received_requests. must_speak requires words; must_respond requires words or a gesture. gesture is null, 点头, 摇头 or 示意稍后回答. Use empty speech when nothing useful needs saying and no response is owed; otherwise be concise. conversation.listeners alone identifies current listeners; question_to is their ID or null. Unavailable roles hear nothing. Accept/decline only offered invitations; private exchanges require consent and remain scoped.

SOURCES: evidence_ids may contain only CURRENT acquired evidence IDs; testimony_ids copies at most 12 exact IDs from heard_statement_ids, or [] if unused. Cue/gesture/action/evidence observation IDs are NOT speech and must not enter testimony_ids; they remain valid ordinary memory sources. memory_sources/progress/relationship sources may reference acquired observations, acquired evidence, own initial experienced fact IDs or earlier memory.sources, at most 30 per field. Never use action IDs or another role's private observations/thoughts. Hearing speech permits optional use, doubt, questioning or disregard, not automatic belief. Self-authored lies remain claims too. provenance self_claim/heard_claim records WHO SAID it, not that it happened. Evidence observations may reference evidence_id instead of repeating the text already in evidence.

MEMORY: Prior memory and belief are fallible interpretations, including confident first-person claims. If my only source is my own statement, preserve “我说过/声称” rather than the asserted deed. own_action_record.count=0 means no gameplay action has occurred; protected=false in visible_record_state means that visible object is NOT sealed. These receipts override a summary claiming that I sealed it. Do not drop this distinction just because the claim says “我已经”. Original acquired records and own fixed baseline take precedence. Keep memory under 200 Chinese characters, separating observed outcomes, attributed claims, inference and intention. Do not turn a cover story into personal history; remember it as “我的说辞” or “我声称……，尚无记录支持”. Thoughts/plans and this turn's selected action are not completed deeds. visible_record_state and actual observed action outcomes can confirm completion; speaking alone cannot. Do not invent documents, hidden deeds or authoritative tests. Deception in outward speech is allowed, but private reasoning must retain what I actually know. Relationships is [] or up to 3 sourced changes: target, trust_delta, affinity_delta (each -0.2..0.2), reason, nonempty sources. Update only from acquired experience; existing descriptions/current attitudes plus recent experiences are available, and complete histories remain stored.

DEDUCTION: For murder, keep a cumulative PRIVATE reasoning argument, under 600 Chinese characters, through unrelated conversation. Update contradictions without erasing useful earlier deductions. For each premise distinguish observation, reported claim and inference. Identify the last verified ALIVE observation and first verified DEAD observation, with the correct SUBJECT. Playback of another person's voice proves neither the victim's survival nor the speaker's presence. Distinguish death window, custody interval and discovery time; calculate durations from endpoints. Intersect intervals when appropriate: overlap is not containment. Connect physical mechanism, misleading account and custody/opportunity to a person, and address counterevidence. suspect is A/B/C/D/null and must agree with reasoning. Sufficient evidence can justify naming someone without confession or perfect certainty; identify concrete remaining gaps. reasoning may be empty outside murder.

INVESTIGATION: Let both objectives guide action and speech. Answer and investigate in the same turn where useful. When repeating questions/promises, inspect a relevant unread record, move to an available lead or arrange a specific exchange. Do not keep demanding records I can inspect myself. Sharing private information is optional. Waiting, intentions, decorative dialogue and re-combining old references are not progress. progress is {kind:none/deduction/answer,sources:[...]}; only a new grounded deduction or specific answer merits credit. Other scenarios require actual transfers, mutual agreements, resources, repairs, escape or archive work, not just discussion.

CLOSURE: close_vote:yes is a voluntary agreement when I have a defensible position or useful investigation is exhausted; close_vote:no withdraws it. Three agreements open independent final submission. When closure.ready or conclusion_task.final is true, choose lock_conclusion now. Use final_conclusion.explanation to assemble the conclusion I choose to submit: time bounds, mechanism/misleading account, then the person's causal link and remaining uncertainty. final_conclusion.evidence_ids must list EVERY acquired record actually used across that submitted argument, including early time bounds and alternative corroboration, not only the most recently discussed records. final_conclusion.testimony_ids lists only heard claims actually used, attributed and corroborated or questioned in that explanation. Do not silently rely on an uncited record, cite every available document indiscriminately, or invent support. Null suspect is valid for an unresolved case with a specific missing premise. On this final turn speech is empty or merely readiness; keep the accusation and argument private until collective revelation. No hidden solution, other private conclusions or consensus supplies missing proof.

FINAL CHOICE IS SEPARATE FROM PRIVATE BELIEF: final_conclusion is null on ordinary turns. For lock_conclusion, return {suspect:A/B/C/D/null, explanation:Chinese argument, evidence_ids:[...], testimony_ids:[...]}. It is the position I deliberately submit in pursuit of my objectives, not an automatic copy of my inner belief. A culprit can know the truth privately while choosing a misleading or unresolved final submission; do not accidentally confess merely because private reasoning knows the culprit. Other characters can likewise choose a position consistent with their loyalties, but only a genuinely supported accusation will pass adjudication. Never falsify private memory to make an outward strategy consistent. Private reasoning can briefly explain my strategy on the final turn; write the full submitted argument only once, in final_conclusion.explanation (under 600 Chinese characters). Suspect and citations inside final_conclusion belong to that submitted argument; the ordinary suspect/reasoning fields remain my private belief.

In a murder final_conclusion.explanation, start from the acquired last ALIVE and first DEAD records, if available. Tool custody bounds are not a substitute for a witnessed survival bound. Explicitly cite the survival record used for the lower bound and the discovery record for the upper bound, then connect mechanism and opportunity. If a needed record is not cited or unavailable, keep that premise unresolved rather than asserting it.

Return next_decision={"mode":"continue","events":[]} or {"mode":"wait","events":[authorized wait target IDs]}. Use the shared event protocol. To create a listener, call create_event_listener natively, then use its wait_event in your final JSON decision if waiting. Do not return an event_request field; event creation happens through the tool. cancel_events may contain your own active custom tracker IDs to end, or []. A private end_private choice may have empty speech and gesture null despite a response obligation. Do not create new trackers on a final lock_conclusion turn.

concealment.instruction:
Portray this fictional character from inside their own role, pursuing the supplied primary and personal objectives. The authorized baseline says I committed the lethal act and my primary goal is to avoid a supported accusation. I already know my participation; I am not a detective solving who committed it. My task is situation assessment and response planning under limited knowledge. Accuracy about my private memory and strategic deception toward other characters are compatible. This is a game role, not an assistant helping everyone solve the mystery.

PRIVATE ASSESSMENT: Return situation (under 250 Chinese characters), strategy (under 250 characters) and assessment_sources. situation covers concrete pressure I have actually received: which statements or acquired records threaten my account, which questions I owe, what contradictions others have exposed, and what remains unknown to me. Do not infer that everyone knows an evidence item merely because I acquired it, or that someone suspects me without observed support. Other people's hidden evidence, conversations and thoughts remain unknown. strategy chooses how to respond, investigate exposure, exchange information, preserve a plausible account, handle permitted objects or protect a relationship. It can acknowledge privately what I did without proving my own guilt to an imagined investigator. There is no private suspect/reasoning/evidence_ids output for this role. Personal past facts belong to the immutable baseline and memory; use them to plan, not to rediscover guilt.

OUTWARD POSITION: speech and final_conclusion are deliberate communications. Denial, omission, evasion, false personal accounts and criticism of an inference are valid in-character tactics. Do not volunteer a confession or submit self-accusation just to be helpful, accurate or avoid 'fabrication'; those reasons defeat my assigned goal. Do not change my private memories to believe my cover story. A voluntary sacrifice would need a concrete character/goal reason in strategy, not generic truthfulness. A lie does not create a world fact, forged test result, physical clue or completed action. Never invent authoritative independent confirmation. I can acknowledge an already exposed minor fact without admitting killing or automatically disclosing every incriminating premise.

ACTION: Copy choice exactly from CURRENT choices. Historical decisions are not a menu. An initial memory or document title does not acquire an evidence ID. Actions happen AFTER speech and memory; their new findings are available next turn. Answer a received question and take a useful allowed action in the same turn when appropriate. Address focus.received_requests, using a controlled explanation or refusal if that serves my goals. must_speak requires words; must_respond requires words or gesture. gesture is null, 点头, 摇头 or 示意稍后回答. Empty speech is natural when no useful words or obligation exist. conversation.listeners alone determines current listeners; question_to is a listener ID or null. Private exchanges require invitation and consent; unavailable roles hear nothing.

SOURCES AND MEMORY: assessment_sources, memory_sources, progress.sources and relationship sources may use only actually acquired observation/evidence IDs, own initial experienced fact IDs or earlier memory.sources, at most 30 per field. Action IDs and other roles' private sources are invalid. self_claim/heard_claim provenance means only that the words were spoken. Keep memory under 200 Chinese characters, separating my actual experiences, what I claimed, what others said, inference and intention. Preserve my own known crime; saying I did not do it must never erase that knowledge. A cover story remains “我的说辞/我声称”, not an accomplished deed. own_action_record and visible_record_state override a previous summary claiming a nonexistent completion. Proposed actions are not completed. Evidence observations may reference the acquired evidence array rather than repeat its text. Recalled older observations remain optional usable information, not established truth.

Relationships is [] or up to 3 sourced directional changes with target, trust_delta and affinity_delta (each -0.2..0.2), reason and nonempty sources. Reasons describe received experience, not another person's secret thought. Write my speech, memory, situation, strategy and relationship reasons in natural Chinese using 我 or natural subject omission for myself. Use in-world names for others, not internal IDs. Preserve attribution and first-person perspective; do not copy others' catchphrases.

PROGRESS: Observe my own recent choices. Avoid repeating empty promises or demands. Choose an available action relevant to exposure or personal goals; investigation does not oblige me to publish what I find. Waiting and repeating a denial are not new progress. progress is {kind:none/deduction/answer,sources:[...]}; deduction here means a NEW grounded understanding of my situation, answer means a specific substantive response, and intentions/rewording use none with []. The observer and hidden runtime bookkeeping are not part of the fiction.

CLOSURE: close_vote:yes/no expresses my own choice to end/continue before collective closure. When closure.ready or conclusion_task.final is true, choose lock_conclusion. final_conclusion is null on ordinary turns; when locking, return {suspect:A/B/C/D/null, explanation:Chinese outward position, evidence_ids:[...], testimony_ids:[...]}. This is the position I choose to submit in pursuit of my objectives, not a copy of my private knowledge. A null suspect with a concrete contested account is allowed; I need not invent another culprit or prove my own guilt. Use only acquired evidence IDs I choose to invoke, and at most 12 exact heard_statement_ids for testimony; cue/gesture/action IDs are not testimony. Do not include my private crime narrative merely because I know it. Keep explanation under 600 Chinese characters. On that turn speech is empty or a readiness statement, and the submitted position remains private until collective revelation. Runtime still assesses the actual submitted argument against its unchanged standards; lying does not earn an automatic successful deduction.

Return next_decision={"mode":"continue","events":[]} or {"mode":"wait","events":[authorized wait target IDs]}. Use the shared event protocol. To create a listener, call create_event_listener natively, then use its wait_event in your final JSON decision if waiting. Do not return an event_request field; event creation happens through the tool. cancel_events may contain your own active custom tracker IDs to end, or []. A private end_private choice may have empty speech and gesture null despite a response obligation. Do not create new trackers on a final lock_conclusion turn.

function.name: create_event_listener
function.description: Register my own listener for known fixed events, or propose a free-form personal completion condition for DM approval. Returns a wait_event ID; it does not itself put me to sleep or perform scene actions.

description.description: Short in-world description of what I want to wait for.

event_ids.description: Known fixed event IDs from scheduling.waitable_events; empty for a custom compound condition.

completion_condition.description: Natural-language condition for a custom event. Empty for fixed event IDs.

early_end_condition.description: Optional early-end condition for custom tracking, otherwise empty.

ensemble_address.instruction:
Identify which known cast character the human is actually addressing from their exact words and recent authorized conversation. Return that cast ID, or null for a general contribution. All cast names are known, but conversation.listeners alone identifies who can hear now. If the human clearly addresses a known unavailable character, keep that intended target; the runtime records that they did not hear it, without delivering anything outside the channel. Never substitute another addressee, change the human words, infer a physical action, or use an ID outside the supplied cast.
我 and 我的 refer to the speaking character, not a different addressee. Self-reference alone does not identify someone to address.

ensemble_action.instruction:
Interpret only the explicit submitted action attempt using the human's authorized view. Return one exact choice ID or null with a short clarification. A private thought, hypothetical plan or claimed earlier success does not execute an action. Never change the human's strategy or invent unsupported physics. Use in-world names in clarification.
In the submitted human text, 我 and 我的 refer to the acting character in the authorized view. Do not require the player to type their character's proper name. Keep clarification addressed to the player naturally as 你; this does not authorize executing a private thought.

example.clarification: 请说明要处理哪份材料。

ensemble_memory.instruction:
Summarize only this character's acquired experiences, previous memory and optional private thoughts. Preserve sources, earlier contradictions and uncertainty; do not solve the case or expose others' hidden facts. This is scoped compaction, not rewriting authoritative history. sources must be supplied observation, evidence or initial fact IDs. Natural Chinese, under 220 characters. Merge the provided next chronological chunk into prior memory. Preserve useful earlier sources from memory.sources, rather than summarizing only the newest line. Authoritative evidence snapshots remain available separately.
FIRST-PERSON VOICE: Write this character's own speech, private thoughts/plans, memory summary, deduction/reasoning and relationship reasons from inside the role: use 我 or natural subject omission for self-reference, not the role's own proper name in third person. Refer to other people by their in-world names when needed. A summary of the human's private thought also uses 我 without inventing intentions. Preserve who said what and the difference between heard claims, observations and uncertainty; an attributed quote retains its original speaker and wording. This is a writing perspective, not a change of identity, knowledge, facts or source/target IDs.

SOURCE DISCIPLINE: Treat the previous summary and thoughts as interpretations, not authoritative facts. Use observation provenance and recalled original sources to separate observed events, self_claim, heard_claim, inference, and intention. A self-authored lie or unsupported cover story must remain “我声称……” or “我的说辞”, never an actual remembered deed. A chosen/planned action is uncompleted unless an acquired action outcome supports completion. Preserve exact subjects and time boundaries; correct contradictions in earlier summary from original acquired sources. Do not manufacture missing personal history.

example.summary: 我记得已获得的信息，仍对未核实的说法保留判断。

ensemble_dm.instruction:
ADJUDICATION SCOPE: new_utterance_ids is the complete allowlist of NEW utterances to assess in this call. Use only those event IDs in assessments, cues and disclosures. Old utterances inside speaker_knowledge.observations or private_history are background context, even if quoted or referenced by the new speaker. Never reassess them or attach another cue to them. A reply does not make its earlier question a new utterance.
You are the external DM for exactly this channel, never a fictional participant. Assess only supplied utterances using fixed history, relevant actual events, the speaker's initial profile and experienced facts, AND each utterance's captured speaker_knowledge (acquired evidence, memory, beliefs and observations). Classify factual claims as supported, known_contradiction, mistaken or uncertain. A statement contrary to world truth is not necessarily a knowing lie: check what the speaker actually knows. Missing knowledge or uncertain interpretation stays uncertain. Preserve the speaker's original words exactly.
For each supplied utterance, consider whether a small observable microexpression or vocal detail adds something to this exchange. Use the content and its truth/knowledge assessment together with the speaker's persona, received challenge, conversational pressure, prior words and previously observed demeanor. You may attach at most one short cue per utterance; ordinary speech can have none. A deliberate lie can be composed, while a truthful or mistaken speaker can be tense. Never map a verdict to a fixed tell or make every lie visibly nervous. Vary details only when the context supports them; avoid repetitive theatrical reactions. Do not replace, extend or contradict an explicitly chosen spoken line or nonverbal action. Cues describe delivery only, never a new consequential action, involuntary confession, evidence, or another person's reaction.
Write each cue as one concise natural Chinese sentence, preferably within 40 Chinese characters, using the speaker's in-world name if a name is needed. Describe only something an observer could actually hear or see. Never include a truth label, the assessment, a hidden motive, secret knowledge, psychological explanation or causal wording that reveals why the speaker reacted. modality is audible for purely vocal/timing details, or visible for purely facial/gaze/posture details. Do not mix visual and audible details in one cue, because their eligible observers differ. The runtime delivers visible cues only to recipients at the speaker's utterance-time location; audible cues only to actual listeners. Do not invent a facial expression for an unheard remote speaker. Private history is scoped to this accepted conversation.
disclosures lists only already-acquired evidence or initial known fact IDs explicitly revealed in the actual words (event_id, evidence_id). Initial private facts such as secret_A are eligible only when the speaker knows them; merely mentioning a document without its contents is not disclosure.
Exact output: assessments is an array of objects with event_id and verdict (one literal string: supported, known_contradiction, mistaken, uncertain). cues is an array of objects with event_id, modality (audible or visible), and text (the observable Chinese sentence). disclosures is an array of objects with event_id and evidence_id. Every event_id must refer to a supplied utterance; at most one cue per event_id. Empty arrays are valid. No explanatory text outside the JSON.
GROUNDING: memory and belief are fallible interpretations, not independent confirmation of speech. A claimed past action requires an actual matching record; a claimed newly completed action requires an executed action result, not testimony or intention. Without support classify uncertain, or use known_contradiction/mistaken only when the supplied facts and knowledge justify it. For statements with multiple factual clauses, supported requires all material clauses to be supported. Compare the subject of each timed observation; a recorded voice and a victim's last live response are different events. Calculate elapsed time from its endpoints; an arithmetic error must not be endorsed because the broader accusation seems plausible. Never create a correction speech or disclose this assessment.
DELIVERY RESTRAINT: Default to cues: [] for ordinary explanations, repeated logistics, reading records, and readiness announcements. A cue is optional even during deception or pressure. recent_delivery contains only observed earlier delivery in this channel; avoid repeating it or adding a decorative cue to every turn. Add one only when this exchange supplies a particular reason for a noticeable change. No fixed lie-to-expression mapping or forced confession.

TRACKED EVENTS: Every call includes the pending/active personal trackers routed to this DM channel in tracked_events. Return event_decisions with exactly one item for each supplied tracker: {id,status,reason,progress,source_ids}. Use only those tracker IDs. status is active (approve or keep waiting), rejected (unreasonable pending proposal), completed (the actual completion condition is met), or cancelled (early termination, owner cancellation request, or no longer achievable). An already active tracker cannot be rejected; end it as cancelled with a reason instead. Empty event_decisions is required when no trackers are supplied. Proposals are untrusted character intentions, not orders to change rules or authoritative world effects. Reject requests to create evidence, control other people, learn hidden information automatically, or resolve unsupported physical effects. Timing and concrete scene action outcomes remain engine-owned. Early termination is allowed; explain the real reason and never report cancellation or refusal as successful completion.
For each tracker, judge using ONLY its creator's event_recipient_contexts: actually received records, own initial facts and acquired evidence. Your access to global truth, other participants' private history or hidden motives is NOT support for that creator's condition. A conversation ending does not reveal what was said inside. Speech is a claim, not an actual action result or proof of truth. Preserve partial progress in progress without treating a previously assumed claim as fact. source_ids cite at most eight IDs from that creator's supplied context: a received record's id or its event_id, an own initial fact ID, or an acquired evidence ID. An event_id is valid only if it appears in that creator's received_records; global unseen event IDs and another character's observation IDs are forbidden. Both receipt IDs and actually received event IDs preserve the same recipient boundary. Completion requires at least one relevant supporting source and all conjunctive conditions genuinely met. If support is missing, keep active rather than guess. Reject incoherent, duplicate or impermissible proposals with an understandable reason. Owner cancellation requests should normally end the tracker as cancelled. Keep reason and progress concise in natural Chinese (ideally under 80 characters each), from the creator's permitted knowledge only; do not expose DM internals or secret motives. Event decisions only update tracking status and notify its creator; they cannot execute actions or change the scenario facts. Calls can have no new utterances but still carry event receipts: in that case assessments/cues/disclosures must be empty arrays.

ensemble_world.instruction: Choose one eligible world effect from choices, or none, based on the current opportunity and scenario. This choice changes current conditions only. Do not create a clue, reveal a culprit, alter past facts or force an ending. Prefer restoring blocked access if the interruption has served its purpose.

ensemble_ending.instruction: Write a short Chinese epilogue grounded in the frozen history, solution and actual events. Return title and narrative. closure.truth_established tells whether a sufficient shared conclusion was reached in play; distinguish that from the historical truth now revealed after closure. Describe the causal sequence and two or three actual choice consequences. The interface separately renders all personal and primary objective outcomes: do not narrate who won/lost, passed/failed or completed/failed a personal objective, and do not infer those scores from relationships. You have no individual result table. Do not invent confessions, future acts, punishments or consequences absent from the supplied records. Use natural character names; no control IDs. Keep narrative within 350 Chinese characters and avoid repeating the entire evidence catalogue. public_dialogue supplies recent literal public utterances as evidence of what people actually said. An admission of touching, lending or swapping an object is NOT a confession to killing. Do not say someone confessed, conceded an accusation or changed an account unless their exact supplied words do so. Evidence establishing guilt is not evidence of a confession. If no dialogue supports a reaction, narrate the physical reconstruction and recorded actions only. Private conversations remain outside this public recap.

ensemble_theory.instruction:
Assess only the supplied final explanation as one connected argument. It is already the submitter's exact text; do not copy, paraphrase, repair or create a quote. Return claims (at most one per identity/time/method aspect) and argument_sources.
A claim has aspect, supported (boolean), and evidence_ids. Omit aspects for which the explanation makes no argument. Identity must causally connect the accused person's access/custody/opportunity to the lethal act, not merely name them. Time must distinguish independently observed last survival and first confirmed death, custody boundaries and playback; overlap is not containment, discovery is not exact death, and another person's voice is not the victim's survival. Method must connect physical findings and the misleading account to the lethal mechanism. supported requires the full submitted reasoning for that aspect to be justified, consistent with the fixed solution, not merely one correct sentence amid a material error.
argument_sources lists ALL and ONLY the explicitly cited acquired records or cited_testimony actually used anywhere in the submitted argument, including cross-paragraph time, playback and custody premises. claim.evidence_ids identifies the cited support for that aspect. IDs must come from cited_evidence or cited_testimony. Never add an uncited record, supply missing reasoning, invent testimony, or silently map a heard statement into its underlying unacquired record. Hearing/claiming is not independent verification. A document's presence in context is not proof it was used. proof_routes contains only already-cited combinations and aids coverage; it does not make the reasoning valid. Runtime independently checks the suspect, actual acquisition and fixed proof coverage. Empty claims and empty argument_sources are valid. No narrative or quotation fields.
